verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents five official SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Java, PHP, Ruby) generated from a shared OpenAPI spec and published to language package registries, with docs guiding developers on how to build against them or the REST API directly. missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration (e.g. GitHub repo stars/activity, community usage reports) of SDK quality/maintenance, and a live discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe found openapi.json paths 404).
